title: Sticker picker
summary: The sticker sheet: My stickers and the packs of this chat, a tap sends the sticker. From here the person also makes a sticker from a photo or imports stickers from WhatsApp (ADR 0029, ADR 0033).

source.description: personal: im.ponies.user_emotes account data. room: im.ponies.room_emotes state of this chat or of a room in im.ponies.emote_rooms.

title.description: bipe_stickers_pack_personal, bipe_stickers_pack_room or the pack name.

stickerCount.description: Images whose usage includes sticker, or that have no usage.

phase.description: loading: reading the packs over the client-server API. empty: no stickers at all.

packs.description: My stickers first, then the packs of this chat.

importResult.description: Stickers added by the last import or photo.

load.effect: Reads the personal pack (Client.accountData im.ponies.user_emotes), the enabled rooms (im.ponies.emote_rooms) and this chat's pack state. Images are normal mxc media (Client.getMediaThumbnail).

send.effect: Sends a standard m.sticker event with the sticker's body, info and url (Room.sendRaw with event type m.sticker; the room encrypts it). Closes the sheet.

fromPhoto.effect: Opens the photo picker; the photo is cut to a 512 px square sticker, uploaded (Client.uploadMedia) and added to My stickers (Client.setAccountData).

importFromWhatsApp.effect: Shows bipe_stickers_import_help and bipe_stickers_import_note, opens the document picker for the exported zip or the sticker files, checks each image (size, format) and adds the new ones to My stickers. Shows bipe_stickers_import_done, bipe_stickers_import_none or bipe_stickers_import_failed.

notes: Pack format: MSC2545 with the im.ponies.* names (ADR 0033). Show images whose usage includes sticker or that have no usage. Keep every other field of a pack when writing it.
Packs are not end-to-end encrypted (account data and room state). bipe_stickers_import_note says so before an import. Sent sticker events in a chat are encrypted as usual.

Room pack state: BipeKit reads it over the client-server API because the SDK does not give custom room state under sliding sync (StickerPackClient). Check Room.stateEvents in the pinned SDK before moving that code; keep the HTTP path if it still does not work.

Bipe logic: StickerPackEventType, Sticker, Sticker.eventContentJSON, StickerPack, StickerPackClient.packs and importStickers, StickerMaker.sticker(fromImageData:), StickerImporter.candidates and candidate, ZipReader, BipeAnimatedImage (iOS); StickerPackEventType, Sticker.eventContentJson, StickerPack.parse and parseEnabledRooms, StickerPackRepository (packs, importStickers, addSticker, makeSticker), StickerImporter (candidates, candidate, fromPhoto) (Android). Move them.
Third-party packs need a licence check (ADR 0029); phase 1 imports only the person's own files.
